resolution.note: coverage assertion moved to test/rules/shard-weight-coverage.test.mjs; message names the manual weight

title: Run the shard-weight coverage test on every fast check
body: Retro of t-3wgr35d (#342): npm run fast passed while CI failed test/ci/shard-weights.test.mjs because two new test files lacked weights; fast selects that test only by import, and its message pointed at `shard-weights-refresh.mjs --write`, which keeps files without CI samples instead of adding them. Acceptance: the coverage assertion lives under test/rules/ (always run by fast) and its message says to add a weight by hand for files without CI samples.
